task:
A fund holds 6260 credits. Its first grant is 19% of that original balance. Return 41% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 3% of the original balance minus 3 credits (the 3 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer.
